correctness.rationale: For pure a|0^n>+b|1^n>, first damping p, subset S of m NOTs (1≤m<n) and second survival r=1-p’, initial vacuum contributes only basis strings supported on S with populations a² r^k(1-r)^{m-k}; excited input contributes independent Bernoulli occupancies pr on S and qr on complement with weight b²; the sole coherent complement pair S/S^c has modulus ab(qr)^{n/2}. The exact published X-state genuine multipartite concurrence theorem yields 2 max{0,z−∑outside pairs√(D_x D_xbar)}. Group 2^m−1 pairs with proper-subset vacuum terms and 2^{n−1}−2^m pure excited pairs to obtain the displayed binomial R(n,m,p,r). Its A(r) factors strictly decrease in r and B_k(r) nonincrease, hence R decreases strictly in r; F(p)=R(p,0) increases continuously from 0 to +∞, so unique p_c separates finite from only endpoint death, with boundary R(p,1)≥1 meaning already dead before stage two. For p=c2^{−2(n−1)/m}, fixed m,a,b and n→∞, only the 2^{n−1}p^{m/2} term survives in F giving (b/a)c^{m/2}; monotone bracketing proves p_c~(a/b)^{2/m}2^{−2(n−1)/m}. Independently constructed density matrix using Kraus operators n=2..4 and 54 (n,m,p,r) parameter combos, agreement with formula to <1e−10.
